title: Reject empty monitor decisions and retain alert delivery outcomes
scope: Repair monitor false-green empty decisions and discarded delivery/recovery retry status without changing scoring, customer state, telemetry schema or building monitoring infrastructure.
non_goals: No queue/schema/full-personalization monitoring, destination provisioning/on-call approval, justified operational SLO or full W12/F10/N19/gate/customer/release acceptance.
No unrelated source, broad suite/new harness, cloud/network/credential/customer-data/commit/push/destructive action or subdelegation; webhook uses synthetic fetch only.

criteria.description: Actual monitor rejects zero records; healthy nonempty remains possible. New results expose check-health ok and separate alert kind/status consistently in returned and successfully stored final record. Problem cooldown and failed/no-webhook recovery retry until sent are preserved; legacy previous results readable.

Actual fixtures cover empty/nonempty, delivery terminal states, recovery retry and tenant cooldown, both-host nondefault examples, synthetic probe no shopper/receipt/learning effects, KV/AE best-effort compatibility and exact prior minimized monitor telemetry case.

Independent actual frozen source/admission-diff/pin/full worker-proof review and exact K1 once; inspect worker compiler/whitespace without rerun. Explicitly retain KV concurrency/durability, destination/on-call and complete W12 limits.
